name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.neg_one_pow_mul_one_sub_pow_mul_zetaNeg
statement:
lemma Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.neg_one_pow_mul_one_sub_pow_mul_zetaNeg (q : ℚ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (-1) ^ k * ((1 - q ^ (k - 1)) * zetaNeg (k - 1))
      = (1 - q ^ (k - 1)) * zetaNeg (k - 1)

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.zetaNeg_eq_zero_of_even

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.zetaNeg_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.zetaNeg_zero : zetaNeg 0 = -(1 / 2)

name: PadicLFunctions.arg_one_sub_exp_ofReal_mul_I
statement:
lemma arg_one_sub_exp_ofReal_mul_I {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t) (ht₂π : t < 2 * Real.pi) :
    Complex.arg ((1 : ℂ) - Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) = t / 2 - Real.pi / 2

name: PadicLFunctions.continuous_shiftedSinTerm
statement:
lemma continuous_shiftedSinTerm (x : ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun s : ℝ =>
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * (i + 1)) / ((i + 1 : ℂ) ^ (s : ℂ))

name: PadicLFunctions.exists_tendsto_sum_range_sin_div_nat
statement:
lemma exists_tendsto_sum_range_sin_div_nat {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    ∃ l : ℝ,
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          if i = 0 then 0 else Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * i) / i)
        atTop (𝓝 l)

name: PadicLFunctions.hasSum_shifted_sinZeta
statement:
lemma hasSum_shifted_sinZeta (x s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * (n + 1)) / ((n + 1 : ℂ) ^ (s : ℂ)))
      (HurwitzZeta.sinZeta x s)

name: PadicLFunctions.hurwitzZetaOdd_apply_zero_of_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem hurwitzZetaOdd_apply_zero_of_mem_Ioo {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZetaOdd x 0 = ((1 / 2 - x : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: PadicLFunctions.hurwitzZeta_neg_nat_of_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem hurwitzZeta_neg_nat_of_mem_Ioo (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta x (-(k : ℂ)) =
      -1 / (k + 1) *
        ((Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)

name: PadicLFunctions.neg_log_one_sub_exp_ofReal_mul_I_im
statement:
lemma neg_log_one_sub_exp_ofReal_mul_I_im {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t) (ht₂π : t < 2 * Real.pi) :
    (-Complex.log ((1 : ℂ) - Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))).im = Real.pi / 2 - t / 2

name: PadicLFunctions.norm_sum_range_shift_le_of_bounded
statement:
lemma norm_sum_range_shift_le_of_bounded
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {z : ℕ → E} {B : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ n, ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i‖ ≤ B) (m n : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z (m + i)‖ ≤ 2 * B

name: PadicLFunctions.norm_sum_range_shift_smul_le_of_antitone_of_nonneg_of_bounded
statement:
lemma norm_sum_range_shift_smul_le_of_antitone_of_nonneg_of_bounded
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {z : ℕ → E} {B : ℝ}
    (ha : Antitone a) (ha_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i‖ ≤ B) (m n : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (m + i) • z (m + i)‖ ≤ (2 * B) * a m

name: PadicLFunctions.norm_sum_range_shifted_sin_term_le
statement:
lemma norm_sum_range_shifted_sin_term_le {x s : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (m n : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * (m + i + 1)) / (((m + i + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (s : ℂ))‖ ≤
      (4 / ‖(1 : ℂ) - Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * x) * Complex.I)‖) *
        (1 / (m + 1 : ℝ) ^ s)

name: PadicLFunctions.norm_sum_range_sin_le
statement:
lemma norm_sum_range_sin_le {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * i)‖ ≤
      2 / ‖(1 : ℂ) - Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * x) * Complex.I)‖

name: PadicLFunctions.norm_sum_range_smul_le_of_antitone_of_nonneg_of_bounded
statement:
lemma norm_sum_range_smul_le_of_antitone_of_nonneg_of_bounded
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {z : ℕ → E} {B : ℝ}
    (ha : Antitone a) (ha_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z i‖ ≤ B) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i • z i‖ ≤ B * a 0

name: PadicLFunctions.one_sub_exp_ofReal_mul_I
statement:
lemma one_sub_exp_ofReal_mul_I (t : ℝ) :
    (1 : ℂ) - Complex.exp (t * Complex.I) =
      (2 * Real.sin (t / 2) : ℝ) *
        (Real.cos (t / 2 - Real.pi / 2) + Real.sin (t / 2 - Real.pi / 2) * Complex.I)

name: PadicLFunctions.sinZeta_one_eq_boundary
statement:
theorem sinZeta_one_eq_boundary {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    HurwitzZeta.sinZeta x 1 = (Real.pi * (1 / 2 - x) : ℂ)

name: PadicLFunctions.tendsto_sum_range_shifted_sin_one
statement:
lemma tendsto_sum_range_shifted_sin_one {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * (i + 1)) / ((i + 1 : ℂ) ^ (1 : ℂ)))
      atTop (nhds (Real.pi * (1 / 2 - x) : ℂ))

name: PadicLFunctions.tendsto_sum_range_sin_div_nat
statement:
lemma tendsto_sum_range_sin_div_nat {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, if i = 0 then 0 else Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * i) / i)
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi * (1 / 2 - x)))

name: PadicLFunctions.uniformCauchySeqOn_shiftedSinPartialSums
statement:
lemma uniformCauchySeqOn_shiftedSinPartialSums {x : ℝ} (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x < 1) :
    UniformCauchySeqOn
      (fun n (s : ℝ) => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * (i + 1)) / ((i + 1 : ℂ) ^ (s : ℂ)))
      atTop (Set.Ici 1)

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.PadicMeasure.compRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compRight_apply (m : C(X, Y)) (f : C(Y, ℤ_[p])) : compRight p m f = f.comp m

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.PadicMeasure.dirac_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dirac_apply (x : X) (f : C(X, ℤ_[p])) : dirac p x f = f x

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.PadicMeasure.exists_locallyConstant_norm_sub_le
statement:
theorem exists_locallyConstant_norm_sub_le (f : C(X, ℤ_[p])) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : LocallyConstant X ℤ_[p], ‖f - (g : C(X, ℤ_[p]))‖ ≤ ε

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.PadicMeasure.pushforward_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pushforward_apply (m : C(X, Y)) (μ : PadicMeasure p X) (f : C(Y, ℤ_[p])) :
    pushforward p m μ f = μ (f.comp m)

name: Tengoku.PadicLFunctions.PadicMeasure.pushforward_dirac
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pushforward_dirac (m : C(X, Y)) (x : X) :
    pushforward p m (dirac p x) = dirac p (m x)
